message:
So the build uses libdeflate 1.18. The vulnerability is in libdeflate's zlib decompression. Let me look at the libdeflate 1.18 source code to understand the `get_unaligned_be16`/`load_u16_unaligned` issue. Let me download the libdeflate source.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /tmp && wget -q https://github.com/ebiggers/libdeflate/archive/refs/tags/v1.18.tar.gz && tar xzf v1.18.tar.gz && ls libdeflate-1.18/lib/</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
